blocks.text: Rere Madrid celebrated her son Atlas turning one month old, while also opening up about adjusting to motherhood and recovering from her C-section. The actress marked the milestone by sharing some of her precious moments with her firstborn, through her Instagram page on Thursday, Oct. 29. “[One] month of being your mama and I’m loving every moment I’m spending with you,” she said. “Our first week together was hard,” she recalled. “Ang hirap mag-recover from CS, lalo na alam kong hindi ko pa kayang alagaan ka full-time the way I wanted to.
